notes.title: Scott Whiskers 2 - Kickstarter campaign running!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hello,  I am delighted to announce the launch of the "Scott Whiskers 2 Kickstarter campaign" for my point-and-click adventure game “Scott Whiskers: The Search for the Golden Cat” - the successor to Scotts first adventure: [/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fancyfactory/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-the-golden-cat"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fancyfactory/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-the-golden-cat[/url][/p][p] 😀 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43829847/dc6bcb64b8e103450e1d19dee726e36a78bd71d2.png"][/img][/p][p]Fans of this almost forgotten genre now have the opportunity to help the project cross the finish line with a small (or not so small) financial contribution. As a reward, you'll get the game at a substantial discount for the platform of your choice, or a strictly limited “Big Box” edition with the game DRM-free on a USB stick, and packaged in a high-quality cardboard box like in the good old days. Or, if you want to go all in, there's also the “Producer” option for a "few" extra bucks. 🙃  [/p][p]Never heard of “Scott Whiskers: the Search for the Golden Cat”? Well, it's the direct sequel to my adventure game [/p][p][url="https://www.scottwhiskers.com/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-mr-fumbleclaw/"]https://www.scottwhiskers.com/scott-whiskers-in-the-search-for-mr-fumbleclaw/[/url][/p][p]  Join Scott Whiskers on the other side of the world in his new adventure and embark on a quest to find a mystical golden cat deep in the jungles of Guatemala. The golden cat is the key to the happiness of a small village - Santo Tomas. And only an expert in missing cats will be up to the task. An expert like Scott Whiskers...  [/p][p]The campaign will still run for ~14 days until July 22, 2025. And it's THE chance to snag some really rare and strictly limited rewards. Rewards like the already mentioned Bix Box. Or Freddy, a small hand-painted lemur. Or a high-quality fabric map. Or a great “making of” photo book. Or... or... or... 🙂  [/p][p][/p][p]All the best, [/p][p]Axel[/p]

notes.title: New option: accelerated voice playback
notes.notes:
As requested several times, an option has now been added to the game settings to speed up or slow down the voice playback. 
Too much text? Speakers too slow? Just set the playback to 125% or 150% and listen to Scott chatter like after 10 cups of strong coffee. 😉

notes.title: We have a release date!!! 🥳
notes.notes:
Yes, we have a release date!!! Start your quest to find the star of the legendary cat beauty contest "Ricky's Finest" - Mr. Fumbleclaw - on March 21!

Scott Whisker's first adventure takes you through a hilarious, family-friendly story full of challenging puzzles, quirky characters and colorful locations. A story about cats, Star Trek and life itself.

notes.title: New Point & Click Adventure Game for your Wishlist!
notes.notes:
[b][h2]A new highlight for your  Wishlist![/h2][/b]
Yeah! Finally! After many years of hard work, the steamsite of the new point & click adventure game "[b]Scott Whiskers in: the Search for Mr. Fumbleclaw[/b]" was released today! There's still some time left until the release, but I'd would be great if you add "Scott Whiskers" already to your wishlist! If you love Point & Click adventures, or animals, or Star Trek - or simply a game with a funny story for all ages - you won't regret it. 😉😀
